envelope.description: runShaper looks up the cache before resolving the scope; bundles record their repository

body.title: runShaper looks up the cache before resolving the scope; bundles record their repository
body.summary: BundleMeta.repoPath: string | null (src/analyze/context/types.ts), admitted by the bundle schema's meta (src/analyze/context/schema.ts) as optional ['string','null'], written on every bundle. runShaper (src/analyze/context/driver.ts) looks up the cache first: a hit with a string repoPath runs ensureRepoQueryable and the freshness read for that repository only; null is served as today; a missing key is a miss. On a miss the scope is resolved once, ensureRepoQueryable runs for every source, then the pairing check, the code-only empty-closure check and the pipeline as today. ShapeOpts.scopeChecked (passed by the factory in src/analyze/context/index.ts into RunShaperArgs.opts) skips the repeated checks; it is not part of the cache key. Grounding: the factory in src/analyze/context/index.ts passes the caller's ShapeOpts whole as runShaper's opts (:93-100, :113-120, :138-145), so scopeChecked reaches runShaper without a new pass-through. Grounding of today's order: src/analyze/context/driver.ts builds the cache key at :336, resolves the scope at :350 (prepareScope), reads freshness from the resolved scope at :357 and looks up the cache at :360. After the change a hit takes its freshness path from the bundle's recorded repoPath, not from a resolved scope.
acceptanceChecks: A cache hit does not call scope resolution (a scopeDeps that throws is never reached) and returns the bundle; a connection-scope hit while another repository's connections file is broken returns the bundle.

A hit for a bundle whose repository is now being indexed is refused with RepoIndexingError and not returned; a bundle without repoPath is a miss; a repoPath null bundle is served without either check.
A hit whose recorded repository has a newer last-indexed time than the bundle is a miss, and the request is built normally.

A freshly built bundle with repoPath (string and null) passes validateBundleWithErrors on the tool-loop and pipeline paths; an older bundle still validates; scopeChecked does not change the cache key.

tests.name: runShaper cache order: a cache hit does not call scope resolution (a scopeDeps that throws is never reached) and returns the bundle; a hit on a connection scope while another repository's connections file is broken returns the bundle
runShaper: a cache hit for a bundle whose repository is now being indexed is refused with RepoIndexingError and the bundle is not returned; a bundle without repoPath is a miss
runShaper: a cache hit whose recorded repository was reindexed since (newer last-indexed time) is a miss and the request is built
bundle schema: a freshly built bundle with repoPath (a string and null) passes validateBundleWithErrors; an older bundle without it still validates
runShaper: a connection-scope bundle (repoPath null) is served from cache without the indexing and freshness checks
